summary: CLMCE is a two-year Erasmus Mundus master's in children's literature, media and cultural entrepreneurship. You start at the University of Glasgow and move on to Aarhus, Nantes, Tilburg or Wrocław. Scholarships pay all tuition, travel insurance and €1,400 a month for 24 months. Scholarship applications close on 22 January 2027 at 13:00 UK time.
meta_title: CLMCE 2027: Erasmus Mundus children's literature scholarship
meta_description: CLMCE pays tuition, insurance and €1,400 a month for a children's literature master's from Glasgow to Aarhus, Nantes, Tilburg or Wrocław. Apply by 22 January.
covers: All tuition fees. Self-funded international students pay £20,260 (€23,385) a year.
€1,400 a month for 24 months (€33,600), or three €1,000 advances plus €1,275 a month.
eligibility: Students from all over the world; up to 90 scholarships over four editions, no more than six per nationality.

An upper second (2:1) or equivalent in English or another modern language, literature, history, film and media, childhood studies, anthropology, sociology, library and information studies, or arts or humanities education.
English: IELTS Academic 6.5 with no part below 6.0. Glasgow exempts only degrees from the UK's majority English-speaking countries, which leaves out Ghana and Nigeria.
Preference goes to applicants without a master's.
how_to_apply: Apply through the University of Glasgow with the scholarship application form (uploaded as a PDF).
Upload your degree certificate and transcript with official English translations, two references on headed paper dated within 24 months, a CV, your English certificate and your passport photo page.
Submit everything by 22 January 2027 at 13:00 UK time. Scholarship outcomes come in April 2027.
watch_out: Scholarship applications missing any document at the deadline are not accepted, and the English certificate must be in by then.
Self-funded students pay a £2,000 deposit; airfares, accommodation, visas and living costs are never covered.
One of the programme's pages still showed 2026 dates in its timeline. Use 22 January 2027.
costs: Tuition (£20,260 a year for international students)
documents: Degree certificate and transcript with English translations
Two references on headed paper, dated within 24 months

faq.q: When is the CLMCE scholarship deadline?
faq.a: 22 January 2027 at 13:00 UK time. Results come in April 2027.
The first semester is at the University of Glasgow; later mobility is at Aarhus, Nantes, Tilburg or Wrocław, with optional summer schools in Vancouver or Mainz and Frankfurt.

faq.q: Do Ghanaian applicants need IELTS for CLMCE?
faq.a: Yes. Glasgow only exempts degrees from the UK's majority English-speaking countries.
